name: Call of Duty: World at War

locations.note: The Soviet campaign culminates in the Battle of Berlin and the assault on the Reichstag.
The Pacific campaign opens with a playable operation on Makin Atoll.
Several Pacific missions recreate the Battle of Peleliu.
April 1945: gunner Locke's PBY Catalina sinks Japanese supply ships bound for Okinawa, then lands to pull survivors of a kamikaze-hit US fleet from the water.
May 1945: Miller's squad assaults Okinawa, ending with the attack on Shuri Castle and the fake surrender.
The Soviet campaign includes the battle for Stalingrad.
April 1945: Reznov finds Petrenko alive on the Seelow Heights, and they break the German line on foot and then in a T-34 on the road to Berlin.

routes.name: Pvt. C. Miller
routes.note: Rescued from his captors on Makin, Miller storms the beaches of Peleliu and ends at the fake surrender at Shuri Castle on Okinawa.

routes.name: Pvt. Dimitri Petrenko
routes.note: From a fountain of corpses in Stalingrad, hunting General Amsel with Reznov, through the Seelow Heights to planting the Soviet flag on the Reichstag.
